notes:
Summary: Spectra Recall is a developer/platform org building an internal code search + RAG platform for engineering productivity. Heavy emphasis on embedding + reranking pipeline. Corpus: ~120M code artifacts (repos, monorepos, package snapshots) + ~30M contextual metadata objects.

Requirements & success criteria (customer-provided):
- Latency: 95th percentile end-to-end search (query -> reranked top-5) <= 200ms for interactive UI; goal 150ms for core flows.
- Throughput: sustained 2000 QPS for batched internal agents during peak builds; spike handling to 6k QPS for short windows.
- Indexing cadence: frequent incremental re-indexing (hourly diffs for hot repos, full delta daily). Target: new code visible in index within 10-15 minutes of commit.
- Scale: initial index size ~150M embedding vectors; expected growth ~25% qtrly. Must support sharded storage and rolling rebalancing without downtime.
- Cost objectives: target cost per interactive query (embeddings + rerank) <= $0.0025; ops wants predictable unit economics for capacity planning.
- Security: must integrate with corporate SSO (SAML IdP, Okta), enforce per-team data residency (EU/NA), KMS-backed key management, and provide audit logs for developer access and API keys.

What we demoed / POC notes:
- 2026-02-15 discovery call (Marcus + Priya present). Customer asked about continuous reindex pipeline and warm KV cache for code completions.
- 2026-02-25 POC kickoff: ingested 2M sampled files, built 4-shard FAISS-like index on Dedicated pilot. Measured 95p latency 180-230ms depending on reranker model.
- 2026-03-02 perf call (SE deep-dive): showed batching + prefix cache reduces token cost by ~18% for typical queries; reranking (cross-encoder) adds 60-80ms.
- POC success criteria agreed: 95p latency <=200ms (interactive), reindex window <=15m for hot subset, cost per 10k queries under $25 with Dedicated config.

Architecture / customer constraints (from SE notes):
- Prefer Dedicated pools in us-west-2 + eu-west-1 to satisfy regional residency.
- Want private control plane with option to run on-prem for audit-blind projects (air-gapped later).
- Routing: route by team region > latency policy > cost fallback to smaller quantized model. Auto-fallback required when primary dedicated pool saturated.

Open technical questions (from internal SE doc):

- Reindex window guarantee with partial commits; need safe-consistent visibility contract.
- Operator story for IdP cert rotation during SAML flows; docs + automation needed.

Commercial / procurement notes:
- Customer prefers committed reserved capacity for predictable ARR; procurement has standard enterprise T&Cs and wants indemnity + breach notification specifics.
- Estimated ARR discussed: $250k-$800k depending on commit level and retention/observability addons.
